description: Modern Law is all about helping people survive divorce. Based in Mesa, Arizona, you'll find a lot of content about the rules and regs for divorce in Arizona, but much of the time, our tips and tools can help you navigate the rough waters of divorce no matter where you live. Need help with an Arizona Divorce or Family Law issue? Contact Modern Law at 480-649-2905 for a consultation today.
